greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.subtitle: Introduction to FAIR HR Consulting's philosophy and vision

content.paragraph1: Since its establishment in 2005, FAIR HR Consulting has been recognized for opening new horizons in corporate consulting by introducing consulting concepts to corporate advisory services. As a result, we currently provide professional advisory services to over 100 corporate clients both domestically and internationally.
content.paragraph2: We have maintained an overwhelming win rate in over 200 labor-related cases (Labor Relations Commission cases, administrative appeal cases, industrial accident insurance rate change request cases, industrial accident cases, etc.), and all our clients know well that this is the result of meticulous logic and thorough preparation.
content.paragraph3: If you want strategies that can solve problems beyond legal knowledge, meet with FAIR HR Consulting. We will become your true partner.

greeting.signature: CEO / Certified Labor Attorney Jung Kwang-il
greeting.quote: We provide strategies that can solve problems beyond legal knowledge

ethics.title: Code of Ethics
ethics.subtitle: 8 Core Values and Ethical Principles Pursued by FAIR HR Consulting
ethics.intro: FAIR HR Consulting has established and adheres to the following code of ethics.
principles: We charge fair and reasonable fees.
We fulfill our strict confidentiality obligations regarding all client information.
We utilize government-supported consulting and subsidies legally and legitimately.
We comply with laws and faithfully perform delegated tasks according to principles and good faith.
We faithfully perform all undertaken work regardless of company size and contract amount.
We avoid free consultations for responsible consulting and consult based on the best interests of our clients.
We provide free consultations for the socially disadvantaged such as disabled persons and basic livelihood recipients, and companies contributing to local communities.
We perform all tasks based on God's justice and love.
